judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime validation and schema caching logic accurately in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, and includes thorough unit and acceptance tests covering all behavioral edge cases (including testing that static schemas compile once across 10 calls, which the reference actually omitted). However, the candidate stopped before finishing the documentation and cleanup facets listed in its own `.lore/dod.md`: it completely missed the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, as well as the required one-line JSDoc comment on `ToolRegistry.execute`. Additionally, the candidate left `.lore/dod.md` in the repository and did not instantiate `Ajv` with `{allErrors: true}`, meaning only the first schema violation is reported per call.
